name: fastify-ledger
description: Scalable double-entry bookkeeping ledger built with Fastify + postgres.js

scripts.db:migrate: docker exec -i ledger-postgres psql -U postgres -d ledger < migrations/001_init.sql && docker exec -i ledger-postgres psql -U postgres -d ledger < migrations/002_initial_balance.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d postgres && sleep 5 && npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:up:direct: docker-compose up -d postgres app && npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:up:pgbouncer: APP_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:ledger@pgbouncer:5432/ledger docker-compose up -d postgres pgbouncer app && npm run db:migrate
scripts.test:load: k6 run -e TARGET_RPS=400 -e MAX_VUS=600 -e PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS=120 tests/load/baseline.js
scripts.test:load:k8s: bash -lc 'set -e; pkill -x kubectl 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kubectl -n ledger port-forward svc/ledger-api 13000:3000 >/tmp/ledger-k8s-pf.log 2>&1 & PF=$!; trap "kill $PF >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT; echo "Waiting for port-forward..."; for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -sf http://localhost:13000/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Ready after ${i}s" && break; sleep 1; done; BASE_URL=http://localhost:13000 k6 run -e TARGET_RPS=400 -e MAX_VUS=600 -e PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS=120 tests/load/baseline.js'
scripts.test:load:nodeport: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://172.27.0.2:30300 -e TARGET_RPS=400 -e MAX_VUS=600 -e PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS=120 tests/load/baseline.js
scripts.test:load:nodeport:1k: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://172.27.0.2:30300 -e TARGET_RPS=1000 -e MAX_VUS=1200 -e PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS=300 -e ACCOUNT_COUNT=5000 tests/load/baseline.js
